description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeManager's command extraction functionality, particularly testing the behavior of extracting wake words and commands from transcribed speech segments.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: Test suite for verifying command extraction logic in VoiceWakeManager.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand returns nil when no trigger words are present in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Verifies that extractCommand correctly trims whitespace and extracts the command following the trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Ensures that extractCommand returns nil if the gap after trigger is shorter than the specified minimum.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Checks that extractCommand returns nil when no additional words follow the trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Tests that empty or whitespace-only trigger entries are ignored in command extraction.
